final_message:
`satisfies` and `maxSatisfying` are implemented in `src/range.ts`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

I also checked about 90 README examples and error cases in a scratch script (now deleted). The two mismatches were mistakes in my expectations, not the code: `>1` correctly accepts `2.0.0`, and `1.2` is a valid range.

Both functions parse the whole range before matching, so an invalid comparator throws even when another set would have matched. I did not add tests beyond the existing three; the README cases are only checked by the scratch script.
